The Chief Specialist will translate reliability and maintenance challenges into scalable business and technology solutions designed to enhance equipment performance, minimize avoidable disruptions, and optimize the total cost of ownership. Establish consistent reliability and maintenance decision principles, directing investment and intervention towards high-value asset risks and opportunities. Translate asset performance, maintenance, and cost challenges into clear improvement opportunities with measurable value hypotheses. Enable proactive, predictive, and risk-based maintenance decisions to improve reliability, maintainability, availability, and total cost of ownership. Utilize asset performance insights to identify recurring reliability constraints and focus improvement initiatives on sustainable performance. Shape end-to-end solutions that integrate asset health monitoring, diagnostics, maintenance planning, and operational execution. Establish closed-loop approaches that leverage asset performance and maintenance outcomes for continuous improvement of reliability decisions. Ensure reliability solutions are scalable, interoperable, and aligned with operational requirements and enterprise technology direction. Align Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, and Supply Chain stakeholders on asset criticality, reliability priorities, and performance outcomes. Partner with analytics, AI, monitoring, and digital teams to translate reliability needs into deployable technology solutions. Integrate reliability initiatives and technical designs to minimize fragmentation, strengthen reuse, and accelerate enterprise adoption. Advance enterprise reliability practices by applying proven methods, technology, and data-driven approaches to priority asset challenges. Build reliability capability through technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and the adoption of consistent practices across relevant teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in asset reliability or a related field. Demonstrated ability to lead and implement enterprise-wide reliability strategies. Strong technical knowledge in asset health monitoring, diagnostics, and maintenance planning. Experience in integrating technology solutions for reliability improvements. Success Metrics Success in this role will be measured by: Consistent definition and application of asset reliability priorities, KPIs, and value outcomes across business units and assets. Improvement in asset reliability, availability, and maintainability through targeted, data-driven interventions. Increased use of proactive, predictive, and risk-based insights in maintenance decisions. Contribution of reliability improvements to lower avoidable disruption and optimized total cost of ownership. Effective closed-loop decision-making across asset health, maintenance planning, and operational execution. Scalability of reliability solutions and technology investments, aligned with business priorities and delivering measurable operational value. cec0a2486fee2a0b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تقنيات التبريد الذكي عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم العمليات المالية للشركة من خلال إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المالية بدقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمحاسبين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المخصصة. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بذلك. تطوير الأداء المحاسبي يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة المتبعة في الشركة. يشمل ذلك مواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال المحاسبة لضمان تطبيق أفضل الممارسات وتحسين كفاءة العمليات المالية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. معرفة جيدة بالمبادئ والمعايير المحاسبية. القدرة على إعداد وتحليل التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي داعم، مما يوفر فرصة للنمو المهني واكتساب الخبرة العملية في بيئة ديناميكية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى شركة تقنيات التبريد الذكي.

ce1d8d8bd9aade9e.description: نبذة عن التدريب نبحث عن متدرب تصميم داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقنا في الرياض. يهدف هذا التدريب إلى تطوير مهارات المشاركين في تصميم المساحات الداخلية، حيث سيعملون مع مصممي الديكور المحترفين. ستتاح للمتدرب فرصة لتطبيق المفاهيم النظرية في بيئة عملية حقيقية، مما يساعده على بناء محفظة عمل قوية. بيئة العمل سيكتسب المتدرب خبرة في العمل ضمن فريق يسعى لتقديم حلول تصميمية للعملاء. نؤمن بتعزيز ثقافة التعاون، حيث يتم تشجيع جميع الأعضاء على تبادل الأفكار والمساهمة في المشاريع. سنوفر التدريب والإشراف اللازمين لتطوير المهارات، بالإضافة إلى فرص لحضور ورش العمل والدورات التدريبية التي تعزز المعرفة في هذا المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات المشاركة في تصميم المساحات الداخلية من خلال إعداد الرسومات والمخططات باستخدام برامج التصميم مثل AutoCAD وSketchUp. مساعدة الفريق في إجراء أبحاث السوق لفهم الاتجاهات الحالية في التصميم الداخلي. التعاون مع فرق متعددة التخصصات لضمان تنفيذ المشاريع وفقًا للجدول الزمني والمعايير المحددة. إعداد العروض التقديمية للعملاء التي تتضمن المفاهيم التصميمية والألوان والمواد. مراقبة تقدم المشاريع والتأكد من توافقها مع الميزانية المحددة. المساعدة في اختيار الأثاث والديكورات المناسبة للمساحات الداخلية. تقديم الدعم في تنظيم ورش العمل والفعاليات التعليمية لتعزيز المعرفة في مجال التصميم الداخلي. تطوير مهارات التواصل من خلال التفاعل مع العملاء لفهم متطلباتهم. المشاركة في تقييم أداء المشاريع بعد الانتهاء منها لتحسين العمليات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التصميم الداخلي. القدرة على استخدام برامج التصميم مثل AutoCAD وSketchUp. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. تفاصيل التدريب المدينة: الرياض. نوع العمل: تدريب. الراتب: 1,875 - 3,750 ريال سعودي. التقديم إذا كنت تبحث عن بيئة عمل داعمة لتطوير مهاراتك في التصميم الداخلي، فنحن نرحب بك للانضمام إلى فريقنا.

ce30dc2a37283efa.description: The Accounting Manager leads and oversees the accounting team of Saudi Arabia and function, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial records and reporting. The role is responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining effective accounting processes and controls for the collection, analysis, verification, and reporting of financial information. In addition, the Accounting Manager collaborates closely with the broader finance leadership team to support sound financial decision-making, compliance, and the achievement of organizational objectives. Duties and Responsibilities Ensure timely and accurate recording of financial transactions and perform monthly closing activities to report US GAAP financials to Regional Management in Europe and the consolidation team in the United States. Perform and/or review periodic account analyses and reconciliations to ensure compliance with internal policies, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements, and internal control standards. Support external auditors during the annual statutory audit, including preparation of financial statements, supporting documentation, and assistance throughout the audit process. Conduct detailed analysis of operating expenses by cost center and division to support financial analysis. Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, including shared service centers, internal audit, Group consolidation team, payroll, tax, and treasury. Assist the Chief Financial Officer in leading and managing the accounting team. Undertake ad hoc tasks and projects as required. Working Capital Management Ensure adequate working capital levels are maintained. Monitor and follow up on collections and outstanding customer claims. Disbursement Functions Review disbursement transactions to ensure compliance with financial controls and Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) requirements. Oversee audit processing of employee expense reimbursements and American Express activity monitoring. Manage monthly expense budgets versus actuals, including sponsorship activities and related financial compliance approvals. Oversee the monthly accrual process. Coordinate with the Shared Service Center for payment processing, including follow-up and timely resolution of issues. Identify and resolve disbursement-related issues in a timely manner. Compliance Tracking and Monitoring Collaborate with the Compliance Committee to monitor outliers in marketing activities using internal tools. Review items of interest to ensure adequate supporting documentation and appropriate remediation. Other Responsibilities Support the Financial Planning team in headcount and cost center expense analysis. Lead the financial business module and Purchase-to-Pay SAP implementation project. Achieve financial objectives by forecasting requirements, preparing annual budgets, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and implementing corrective actions. Confirm financial status by monitoring revenues and expenses, and coordinating the collection, consolidation, and evaluation of financial data, including the preparation of special reports. Maintain accounting controls by establishing a chart of accounts and defining accounting policies and procedures. Provide guidance to other departments by interpreting accounting policies and recommending operational improvements. Ensure financial security through the implementation of internal controls. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations by staying informed of current and proposed legislation and recommending necessary updates to procedures. Safeguard organizational value by maintaining strict confidentiality of financial information. Contribute to the achievement of organizational objectives by delivering required results as needed. Desired Candidate Profile Skills and Competencies Professionally certified or chartered accountant/Holding master’s degree in financial accounting from a recognized international institute, or currently pursuing such certification; an MBA in Finance with relevant experience is also desirable. Minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience in an accounting or finance function along with at least 2 years of experience as people manager. Experience in the pharmaceutical industry is preferred but not mandatory. Strong project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines. Demonstrated experience working within a matrix organization. Fluency in English, both written and spoken; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage. Previous experience with a Big 4 firm is highly desirable. Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and a proactive approach. Proficiency in ERP systems, preferably SAP (FI), and advanced skills in Microsoft Excel (including PivotTables and macros). High attention to detail and willingness to engage with complex data. Strong leadership skills, with the ability to manage and support a team in challenging situations. Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills. Preferred Saudi National Required Skills: Accounting Applications, Accounting Applications, Accounting Management, Adaptability, Ad Hoc Reporting, Budget Analysis, Budget Management, Budget Variance Analysis, Chart of Accounts (COA), Compliance Reporting, Credit Management, Credit Risk Assessment, Expense Tracking, External Audit, Financial Accounting Controls, Financial Analysis, Financial Compliance, Financial Controlling, Financial Data Reporting, Financial Forecasting, Financial Oversight, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Financial Transactions, Internal Financial Control, Managerial Accounting {+ 8 more}

ce32c1e21c5fe1f0.company_name: مجمع الميدان الدولي لطب وتقويم الاسنان
ce32c1e21c5fe1f0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أم القرى التجارية عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم رعاية أسنان شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من التشخيص وحتى تنفيذ الخطط العلاجية ومتابعتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة، وإعداد الخطط العلاجية المناسبة والجداول الزمنية لها. إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بما في ذلك الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية اللازمة للمرضى. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. مواكبة التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان وتطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارة في إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الطبية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة أم القرى التجارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

ce3410f2574ebfc5.description: About the Role Al-Qahtani Pipe Coating Industries (AQPCI) is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role involves the implementation of electrical components into devices and contributing to the design and manufacturing of electrical products. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring high product standards through quality assurance checks. Key Responsibilities Conducting testing of electrical equipment. Performing root cause analysis for electrical issues. Selecting and programming PLCs. Leading automation activities within existing facilities. Calculating load demands and selecting appropriate electrical components. Initiating ideas for electrical power saving. Studying electricity consumption and proposing improvements. Organizing and conducting maintenance plans. Preparing electrical load lists for facilities and drawing single-line diagrams. Preparing procurement plans and scheduling deadlines. Leading on-site execution of projects, including preparing load distribution and layouts. Candidate Requirements Candidates should possess 4+ years of experience in a relevant electrical engineering role. The ability to perform quality assurance checks is essential to maintain product standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, within Al-Qahtani Pipe Coating Industries (AQPCI).

ce3496e4499aa96d.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform focused on emerging markets, recognized as a Great Place to Work®. The company has over 25 years of conversational AI research and development, serving more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA. Unifonic pioneers sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform and values creativity, collaboration, and innovation from its employees. The Engineering Team The Engineering team at Unifonic is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of the systems and technologies that power Unifonic’s solutions. This team collaborates with other departments to ensure that products and services meet customer needs. Unifonic encourages individuals passionate about technology and cutting-edge communication solutions to join the team. Role Summary: Arabic Linguist – AI & TTS Unifonic is seeking an Arabic Linguist to support the Text-to-Speech (TTS) team. This part-time role, based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, involves linguistic analysis, Arabic dialect expertise, pronunciation and speech-quality evaluation, and various voice-related projects. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Saudi Arabic dialects, with native or near-native proficiency in the Najdi dialect being highly preferred. This position offers an opportunity to contribute linguistic expertise to production projects and enhance the quality and naturalness of Arabic speech technology. Key Duties and Responsibilities Conduct research on the phonological, morphological, and syntactic structures of Arabic, with a focus on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and Saudi/Gulf dialects, particularly the Najdi dialect, providing linguistic guidance for integration into Sestek products. Serve as a linguistic point of contact for the R&D / AI team, translating linguistic requirements into clear, actionable input for engineers. Analyze and review pronunciation data, including grapheme-to-phoneme mappings, diacritization/tashkeel, and lexicons, for Arabic TTS and speech recognition systems. Evaluate TTS output quality, focusing on pronunciation accuracy, prosody, dialect authenticity, and naturalness, particularly for Saudi Arabic. Provide linguistic guidance and support for Arabic voice data collection and speech synthesis projects, including identifying and onboarding suitable voice talents as needed. Support the coordination and review of voice recording and editing processes to ensure linguistic accuracy and consistency. Support the onboarding and coordination of external Arabic language consultants when required, providing guidance on linguistic requirements. Review and provide linguistic feedback on data annotation activities and guidelines, ensuring appropriate quality standards for Arabic and Saudi dialect data. Collaborate closely with the Sestek TTS and AI Research teams, providing ongoing linguistic expertise throughout projects. Required Character Traits Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving: Ability to approach problems clearly, utilize data, and identify effective solutions. Ownership and Accountability: Demonstrates responsibility and ensures projects are completed. Communication: Clearly articulates ideas and actively listens to others across teams. Collaboration: Works effectively with others and supports team objectives. Adaptability and Learning: Adjusts to changes and continuously acquires new skills or tools. Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Supports the growth of others and shares expertise. Resilience: Maintains composure under pressure and addresses setbacks constructively. Quality and Attention to Detail: Executes work meticulously and strives for continuous improvement. Advocacy and Innovation: Promotes best practices, efficiency, and new ideas.

ce378c417f622f6f.description: About the Role Edition is seeking a Director of Engineering to oversee all aspects of hotel maintenance in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves providing high-level maintenance knowledge, managing building and mechanical equipment, and ensuring safety, security, and asset protection. The Director will be responsible for budget management, capital expenditure projects, preventive maintenance, and energy saving initiatives, while ensuring compliance with standards and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage engineering operations and budgets, working with leadership to identify areas needing attention. Oversee mechanical equipment, including refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment, and electrical systems, according to standard operating procedures. Execute service contracts to support hotel needs and ensure fire safety personnel understand all procedures and equipment. Guide the engineering leadership team in managing controllable expenses such as wages, utilities, tools, and supplies. Develop engineering operations strategies aligned with hotel and brand business goals. Oversee the implementation of long-term preventive maintenance and 10-year asset protection plans. Review financial reports, propose solutions for concerns, and ensure construction projects are completed on time and within budget. Maintain engineering standards, ensuring compliance with state, local, and federal regulations. Manage the hotel's fire safety system and ensure all building and equipment permits are current. Oversee payroll and manage departmental controllable expenditures to meet or exceed budget goals. Participate in setting departmental capital expenditure goals and the budgeting process. Prepare weekly and period-end profit and loss assessments. Ensure fair and consistent implementation of hotel policies and manage disciplinary procedures. Address employee issues and guest complaints, escalating to HR when necessary. Lead emergency response teams for equipment issues. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in engineering maintenance or a related professional field is required. Candidates must have received HVAC refrigeration/electrical/plumbing technical training. One of the following educational backgrounds is required: High school diploma or GED with 6 years of experience in engineering maintenance or a related professional field. Two-year degree in construction, engineering, mechanics, or a related major from an accredited university with 4 years of experience in engineering maintenance or a related professional field. Operational Management The role involves developing and implementing strategies to deliver products and services that meet or exceed guest and employee expectations, while optimizing financial performance. This includes active response to potential concerns and proposing solutions to owners, as well as clear communication of departmental goals to achieve expected results. Human Resources Activities The Director of Engineering will ensure employees are treated fairly and consistently, adhering to hotel policies, SOPs, and LSOPs for disciplinary procedures. This includes utilizing employee feedback and open-door policies to resolve issues promptly and recognizing team member contributions. Regular communication within engineering operations is essential to convey daily activities, set expectations, and enhance business goal awareness. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, focusing on maintaining high standards in a dynamic hotel environment. The role requires a proactive approach to operational challenges and a commitment to continuous improvement in engineering services.

ce41a44bb466ec01.description: About the Role EDITION is seeking a Chef de Partie to join its team. This full-time role involves preparing and cooking food items according to established standards, ensuring quality and presentation, and supporting kitchen operations. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Prepare special meals or substitute items as required. Regulate temperatures of cooking equipment, including ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Manage food thawing processes from freezer storage to refrigeration. Ensure proper portioning, arrangement, and garnishing of food. Maintain accurate food logs and monitor the quality and quantity of prepared food. Communicate staffing needs during busy periods and inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff about menu specials and out-of-stock items. Prepare and cook food in adherence to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklists. Prepare cold food items. Operational and Team Support Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Serve as a role model for team members. Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure personal appearance and uniform are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs. Communicate professionally and clearly with others. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support the team in achieving common goals. Listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. About EDITION Hotels EDITION Hotels combine the vision of boutique hotelier Ian Schrager with the service delivery of a luxury hotel and the global reach of Marriott International. The brand aims to provide a distinct hospitality experience, balancing polish with personality, perfectionism with individualism, and comfort with charisma. EDITION targets sophisticated consumers who value quality, originality, design, and service excellence without conventional limitations. Joining EDITION EDITION seeks individuals who are inspired, challenged, and proud of their work environment. Joining EDITION means becoming part of the Marriott International portfolio of brands, offering opportunities to perform at your best, pursue your purpose, and belong to a global team.

ce565e415dd4f082.description: About Sunon Furniture Sunon Furniture is seeking a Business Development Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on expanding the company's market presence across the country. Role Summary The Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving market expansion in Saudi Arabia. This involves proactive business development with government entities, design firms, contractors, and end-users to position the Sunon Furniture brand and products throughout the country. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute business development strategies targeting key government institutions and private sector clients. Build and maintain relationships with architects, interior designers, contractors, fit-out companies, and end-users to drive brand specification at the project design stage. Identify and pursue business opportunities from government and design channels, converting leads into sales. Travel across Saudi Arabia as needed to meet clients at project sites and build local networks. Coordinate client meetings and presentations for the reporting manager to ensure high-level engagement runs smoothly. Represent the company professionally and uphold brand reputation. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant business development role. Based in Riyadh, KSA, with the ability to travel domestically as required. Professional appearance with strong communication and presentation skills. Willing and able to engage in frequent client visits and front-line business development activities. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires regular travel within the country to meet clients and develop networks. The position is full-time. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

ce69a77b7e9ad76f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن فني دعم تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة للموظفين والعملاء في حل المشاكل المتعلقة بتقنية المعلومات، وتحديد المتطلبات اللازمة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة للموظفين والعملاء الذين يواجهون مشاكل في تقنية المعلومات، والإجابة على استفساراتهم بهدف حل المشاكل التقنية. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات المطلوبة لأعمال دعم الموظفين والعملاء وحل المشاكل، ورفع النواقص إلى الجهات المعنية لتأمينها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. توفير المعلومات الفنية الخاصة بأجهزة ونظم وبرامج تقنية المعلومات، والرجوع إلى أخصائيي تقنية المعلومات عند الحاجة لمشاكل معقدة. حفظ البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بجميع عمليات الدعم الفني المقدمة، وتنظيمها وتبويبها بناءً على الممارسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال دعم تقنية المعلومات. القدرة على تحديد المشاكل التقنية وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم الفني بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع الموظفين والعملاء لتقديم الدعم الفني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور.

ce8e7d997da6b7d5.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a QHSE Manager for a full-time position in Tabuk, Tabuk. This role involves leading and managing all Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental (QHSE) aspects on a Water Pipeline project. The QHSE Manager will ensure that contractors and project teams deliver work safely, in compliance with statutory, client, and contractual requirements, and to the required quality standards, while protecting people, assets, and the environment. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain the project QHSE Management Plan, procedures, and governance framework, aligned with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and client/regulatory requirements. Review and approve contractor QHSE plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, risk assessments, and environmental management plans before work commences. Provide QHSE oversight for high-risk pipeline activities, including deep excavations, trenching, lifting operations, pipe stringing and welding, hydrotesting, confined space entry, crossings, and tie-ins to live infrastructure. Lead site inspections, audits, and surveillance of contractors, verifying compliance with QHSE requirements and driving the timely close-out of non-conformances (NCRs) and corrective actions. Oversee quality assurance and control of pipeline materials and works, including material inspections, welding and coating quality, NDT, pressure testing, and as-built verification. Lead incident reporting, investigation, and root cause analysis, ensuring lessons learned are shared and preventive actions are implemented across the project. Manage environmental compliance, including permits, waste management, dust and noise control, dewatering, ecological and archaeological protection, and site reinstatement. Drive road safety, fatigue management, and journey management across the long linear worksite, including traffic management at road crossings and haul routes. Monitor, analyze, and report QHSE performance (leading and lagging KPIs) to the Project Director and senior management, with clear recommendations for improvement. Promote a strong safety and quality culture through leadership engagement, campaigns, toolbox talks, inductions, and recognition initiatives. Ensure emergency response, medical, and evacuation arrangements are in place and tested across remote pipeline locations. Support testing, commissioning, and handover, ensuring QHSE and quality documentation is complete and accepted for project close-out. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or a related discipline. NEBOSH International Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety (or equivalent). ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 Lead Auditor certification. A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required. Chartered membership of IOSH, CQI, or IEMA (or equivalent) is highly desirable. Work Environment This role is based in Tabuk, Tabuk, and involves working on a water pipeline project. The position is full-time and requires active management of QHSE matters across various site activities, including remote locations. Company Overview Parsons fosters an innovative culture that empowers employees to achieve their full potential. The company is guided by a leadership vision that values people, embraces agility, and fosters growth. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

Promote GPTW assessments, programs, and events to enhance brand visibility and engagement in the KSA market. Follow up on inbound leads, marketing campaigns, and event attendees to convert interest into qualified opportunities. Plan and execute demand generation activities with the Marketing team to build awareness of Great Place to Work® solutions. Engage target audiences through coordinated email, LinkedIn, webinar, and event campaigns, using relevant workplace culture content. Align with Sales and Marketing on target audiences, campaign messaging, lead qualification criteria, and timely follow-up. Track demand generation activity and results in the CRM, including lead sources, engagement, qualified opportunities, and pipeline contribution. Work closely with the Managing Director – KSA on client engagement, market development initiatives, and strategic outreach. Prepare weekly reports on pipeline status, outreach performance, and market insights. Coordinate internally to ensure consistent communication, high-quality delivery, and alignment across all touchpoints. Drive new business growth by proactively identifying and pursuing opportunities across priority sectors in the KSA market. Proactive outreach and relationship-building abilities. Proficiency in maintaining CRM records and tracking performance. Performance Indicators Outbound leads generated and qualified meetings booked. Lead to opportunity conversion rate. CRM accuracy and data quality. Timely support provided to Sales, Marketing, and the Managing Director. Outreaching activity levels and quality of weekly reporting. Sales-qualified pipeline value generated and new target accounts engaged. Qualified opportunity conversion rate and contribution to new client acquisition. Execution of targeted growth initiatives and demand generation campaigns, including resulting qualified leads and sales-qualified pipeline.

Supervise daily Spa Reception and Treatment operations to ensure a seamless and personalized guest experience. Ensure compliance with Health and Safety regulations and hotel procedures. Report hazards, defects, and safety concerns immediately. Ensure incidents and accidents are reported in line with procedures. Maintain compliance with HACCP and food safety standards. ce0d794caa6488d3.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Site Manager Electrical (Substation) to oversee electrical construction execution for projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a professional with a strong background in electrical engineering and extensive experience in EHV/HV substation projects, particularly those involving 380kV BSPs. Role Overview The Site Manager Electrical will be responsible for the overall electrical construction execution, site coordination, and timely project completion in accordance with SEC standards and project requirements. The role involves managing subcontractors, ensuring quality and safety, and monitoring progress for 380kV substation projects. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage electrical construction activities for 380kV substation/BSP projects. Plan and monitor site execution, including manpower, materials, equipment, and daily progress. Coordinate with SEC, consultants, subcontractors, and project teams to ensure smooth execution. Ensure all works comply with SEC standards, approved drawings, specifications, and project procedures. Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, cable works, equipment erection, and related electrical activities. Monitor project schedules, identify potential delays, and implement corrective actions to achieve project milestones. Review drawings, method statements, ITPs, and technical documents prior to execution. Manage subcontractors to ensure productivity, quality, safety, and timely completion of their scope. ce5679d5e54f0359.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معمار للتطوير والاستثمار عن مهندس معماري داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى المساهمة في تطوير وتنفيذ التصاميم الداخلية للمشاريع، مع التركيز على إعداد الرسومات التنفيذية والعروض التصميمية الاحترافية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير التصاميم الداخلية والرسومات التنفيذية والتفصيلية. استخدام برامج التصميم مثل AutoCAD وRevit وبرامج الرندر لإخراج التصاميم بصورة احترافية. إعداد العروض التصميمية (Presentation) للمشاريع. فهم التفاصيل المعمارية ومتطلبات التنفيذ وتطبيقها على الرسومات. اختيار المواد والتشطيبات المناسبة بما يتوافق مع التصميم المقترح ومتطلبات المشروع. مراجعة وتحديث المخططات وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة. التنسيق والتعاون مع فريق العمل والجهات ذات العلاقة لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الداخلي أو الهندسة المعمارية الداخلية. إتقان استخدام برامج التصميم الهندسي مثل AutoCAD وRevit وبرامج الرندر. القدرة على إعداد عروض تصميمية احترافية. المهارات المطلوبة فهم عميق للتفاصيل المعمارية ومتطلبات التنفيذ. القدرة على اختيار المواد المناسبة التي تتوافق مع الهوية والتصميم المقترح. الالتزام بالدقة والجودة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع مراحل العمل. مهارات تواصل وتعاون فعالة مع فريق العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري الداخلي ضمن فريق شركة معمار للتطوير والاستثمار في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل تعاونية تركز على تحقيق الجودة والاحترافية في جميع المشاريع. تقديم الطلبات نرحب بالمرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات هذا الدور لتقديم طلباتهم.

Execute equipment and project procurement processes as assigned by the Immediate Superior. Perform advance payment transactions with the finance department based on PO or Contract Terms. ce352747a0fab84d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نبيه بن عبدالرحمن بن محمد الشعيبي للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث سيقوم بتنفيذ أعمال المسح الميداني ورسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية لمختلف المشاريع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية للمشاريع الإنشائية المختلفة وإعداد مسودات للمنشآت والعوائق والقنوات والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط، واختيار الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المناسبة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية المتنوعة. إجراء أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي، وتثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية من المخططات على الأرض. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات، وتثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها، وتوقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية والمنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة المختلفة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المساحة. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية المساحية. مهارة في استخدام الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية. القدرة على قراءة ورسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المساحة ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة نبيه بن عبدالرحمن بن محمد الشعيبي للاستشارات الهندسية بالهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية بدقة واحترافية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذه الفرصة المهنية.

ce96d75a30769c71.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فرع شركة سوسيداد ايبيريكا دي كونستركشنز الكتريكاس عن مهندس اتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد خطط تركيب وتشغيل مقاسم الاتصالات المركزية والفرعية، بالإضافة إلى تخطيط شبكات الاتصالات السلكية واللاسلكية ومتابعة تنفيذها. يشمل الدور أيضاً إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة تنفيذها، وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية رفع مستوى معرفة موظفي المشروع بأنظمة CAFM (أنظمة الإدارة المساعدة للمرافق بالحاسب الآلي). ضمان تحقيق أهداف الرقابة الفنية، وضبط التكاليف، والالتزام بالجدول الزمني للأعمال بشكل منهجي ومستمر. تطوير نظام تدريبي متكامل للتدريب الداخلي في مجال مراقبة الأعمال (Work Control) لجميع الموظفين، يشمل تخطيط القوى العاملة، وتقنيات قياس العمل، وإدارة الموارد، وإجراءات السلامة. التنسيق مع موظفي مشروع PMS لحصر وتجميع جميع متطلبات التشغيل المتعلقة بأعمال مراقبة الأعمال (Work Control). ضمان إنجاز الأعمال بالشكل المطلوب وفقًا للمعايير واللوائح والسياسات المعتمدة، وتحقيق أفضل كفاءة في أداء الموظفين بما يضمن فعالية التكلفة وجودة تنفيذ الأعمال. إعداد ومتابعة التقارير اليومية والأسبوعية والشهرية. عقد اجتماعات دورية مع الموظفين التابعين لضمان وضوح الأولويات وسير الأعمال والإجراءات بسلاسة. إعداد وتشغيل نظام متكامل للصيانة الوقائية المخططة (PPM) لتحديد جميع أعمال الصيانة الوقائية المطلوبة لمشروع PMS، وضمان تنفيذها وفقًا للمتطلبات المحددة. ضمان التشغيل السليم لجميع الأنظمة التشغيلية في المحطات، مثل نظام اتصالات TOMS، ونظام مراقبة المحطات، ونظام الإعلانات، وغيرها من الأنظمة ذات الصلة. مراقبة نظام TOMS وتشغيله عند الحاجة. تنفيذ تطبيق وتوسعة نظام إدارة الصيانة المحوسب (CMMS) بما يتوافق مع متطلبات المشروع. إبقاء مدير التشغيل على اطلاع دائم بحالة سير العمل، وحجم عبء العمل، والمشكلات، ومستوى التقدم في تنفيذ المهام الموكلة. ضمان تحديث جميع أنظمة التشغيل بما يتوافق مع أحدث ممارسات وإجراءات العمل. التأكد من أن جميع أقسام مشروع PMS تستخدم نظام CAFM الخاص بجامعة الملك سعود بن عبدالعزيز للعلوم الصحية (KSAU-HS) بشكل كامل وفعّال. تطوير أنظمة وآليات لمراقبة الأعمال بما يضمن الاستخدام الأمثل لموارد القوى العاملة. تطوير مؤشرات أداء لقياس ومتابعة فعالية عمليات مراقبة الأعمال وتقييم أدائها. أداء أي مهام وظيفية أخرى ذات صلة يتم تكليفه بها. الإشراف على أعمال مشغلي مركز التحكم التشغيلي (OCC Operators). المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال هندسة الاتصالات أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لأنظمة CAFM وأنظمة إدارة الصيانة المحوسبة (CMMS). القدرة على إعداد خطط التركيب والتشغيل لشبكات ومقاسم الاتصالات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع فرق العمل المختلفة. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ برامج تدريبية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ويتطلب العمل ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في فرع شركة سوسيداد ايبيريكا دي كونستركشنز الكتريكاس.

cec53bc3b68e4a02.description: About the Role SME Careers is seeking an Arabic Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) for a contract, remote position based in Mecca, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing quality, consistency, and trainer performance across various Arabic AI training projects. The QAL will review AI-generated Arabic content and work from trainers and QAs, ensuring adherence to project guidelines and quality standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Context and Impact As an Arabic Quality Assurance Lead, you will evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure all contributors follow expected quality standards. This includes assessing work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. Your leadership will contribute to improving AI models by ensuring Arabic training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. Key Responsibilities Monitor quality by spot-checking Arabic items, identifying issues, providing feedback, and escalating critical concerns. Communicate updates to trainers and QAs regarding guidelines, project changes, workflow, and quality expectations. Respond to trainer/QA questions promptly, focusing on Arabic wording, grammar, register, dialect, RTL formatting, translation fidelity, terminology, and cultural context. Manage trainer/QA activation by contacting inactive contributors, encouraging participation, tracking follow-ups, and flagging availability issues. Create and maintain Arabic project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, and onboarding materials. Schedule and conduct onboarding/training calls for trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, and Arabic-specific style requirements. Ensure consistent application of Arabic language guidelines by all trainers and QAs as projects evolve. Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and assist in building scalable QA processes for Arabic-language projects. Required Skills and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong proficiency in both Arabic and English. Excellent attention to detail. Structured communication skills. Ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. Application Process The selection process for this role includes an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. While there is no immediate project for this role, qualified candidates will be among the first contacted when relevant opportunities arise and will gain access to future projects within our expert network.

cec5f30aca7f279a.description: نبحث عن بائع اتصالات متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا وتقديم تجربة عملاء استثنائية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن مساعدة العملاء في اختيار أفضل خطوط الاتصالات والأجهزة التي تلبي احتياجاتهم. انضم إلينا لتكون جزءًا من بيئة عمل ديناميكية ومجزية. مهام الوظيفة: * تقديم استشارات متخصصة للعملاء حول منتجات وخدمات الاتصالات. * بيع وشرح باقات وعروض شركات الاتصالات المختلفة. * مساعدة العملاء في تفعيل الخدمات وتحديث اشتراكاتهم. * تحقيق الأهداف البيعية المحددة وتقديم تقارير دورية. * الحفاظ على مستوى عالٍ من رضا العملاء.

ceec3b4561dc7412.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فيتال ميديتك عن محضر مختبر علوم للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان جاهزية مختبرات العلوم لتنفيذ التجارب العلمية بكفاءة ووفقًا للإجراءات المنظمة، مع الالتزام بمعايير السلامة وإدارة المخاطر. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحضير مختبرات العلوم لضمان أداء التجارب العلمية المطلوبة. صيانة وتشغيل معامل قسم الأحياء بما يدعم العملية التعليمية. تنفيذ خطط الكلية المتعلقة بمعامل العلوم. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات الضرورية لتنفيذ التجارب العلمية في المختبر. ضمان توفر كافة الموارد اللازمة لأداء التجارب العلمية قبل البدء بها. التنسيق مع الأساتذة واختصاصيي المختبر للتأكد من توفير مستلزماتهم قبل بدء التجارب. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية المعتمدة. تنفيذ خطط السلامة العامة وإدارة المخاطر في المختبرات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تحضير مختبرات العلوم أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل وفقاً للإجراءات المنظمة والتعليمات الموجهة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ السلامة والصحة المهنية في بيئة المختبرات. بيئة العمل يعمل محضر مختبر العلوم بدوام كامل ضمن مؤسسة فيتال ميديتك في مدينة نجران. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع أعضاء هيئة التدريس واختصاصيي المختبر لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مؤسسة فيتال ميديتك.

cefb31682412e2e4.description: About the Role Cornerstone Global Partners (CGP Group) is seeking a PMO Manager to support a client on a high-profile operational readiness program in Neom, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring a professional with 5-10 years of experience. Role Overview The PMO Manager will serve as the primary interface between the client, Neom, and its various stakeholders. The role involves coordinating activities, aligning schedules, and ensuring the successful delivery of readiness milestones for the program. Key Responsibilities Act as the key interface between Neom, its stakeholders, and the client. Coordinate stakeholders and align schedules, delivery activities, and readiness milestones. Report progress to project management and project controls teams, collaborating with a Project Manager, scheduler, and risk analysts. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated excellent stakeholder coordination and communication skills. Ability to apply a practical approach to complex interfaces. A background in consultancy or Project Management Consultancy (PMC) is preferred. Experience with Neom or in the energy sector is considered an advantage. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Neom, Saudi Arabia. Candidates must be willing to reside full-time at the Neom location to fulfill the responsibilities of the role. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon initial contact. The salary for this position is not disclosed.

ce2102b0c85d7676.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع النعيرية الأهلي عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقه في النعيرية، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءاً من تقييم حالتهم الصحية وحتى توثيق الإجراءات الطبية، مع ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض وجمع البيانات من المريض وذويه وتوثيقها وتحليلها، وتحديد احتياجات المريض من الرعاية. إعداد خطة الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية بحسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية وفقاً لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، والمشاركة في عملية الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي بدقة واحترافية. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. تطوير العمل يتوقع من أخصائي التمريض في هذا الدور المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات المستمرة في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان تقديم أفضل خدمة ممكنة للمرضى. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمريض. القدرة على إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع النعيرية الأهلي بالمنطقة الشرقية، النعيرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولم يتم الكشف عنه في الوقت الحالي.

ce284d542de5be88.description: About the Role The Management Recruitment Group (MRG) is seeking an experienced Interior Designer for a client, a Real Estate Development company, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves joining an in-house technical services team to support the delivery of residential apartment and hotel projects. The role requires a technically strong interior design professional capable of managing consultants, coordinating complex packages, and maintaining consistent quality across multiple concurrent projects. Role Context and Responsibilities Reporting to the Lead Architect, the Interior Designer will review external consultants’ submissions, guide revisions, and ensure interior design packages meet project briefs, brand standards, and operational requirements. This role is crucial for ensuring designs are technically coordinated, buildable, and delivered within agreed programs. The position carries technical review responsibility for external consultants’ work, with no direct line reports. The role is predominantly office-based, with site visits required according to project needs. Key Responsibilities Review interior design consultant submissions from concept through schematic and detailed design, including drawings, specifications, and FF&E packages for residential apartment and hotel projects. Issue clear technical comments and follow up with consultants to ensure revisions are incorporated accurately and within agreed deadlines. Assess design packages for technical quality, completeness, and compliance with project briefs, brand standards, and quality requirements. Coordinate interior design with architectural, MEP, joinery, and fit-out packages, identifying and resolving clashes, gaps, and interface issues. Identify design decisions that could affect cost, program, or buildability and escalate risks to the Lead Architect. Manage consultant deliverables and track outstanding design reviews, revisions, and coordination matters across multiple concurrent projects. Support multidisciplinary design reviews and clash detection, ensuring interior design requirements are integrated into wider project documentation. Coordinate responses to site requests for information (RFIs), working closely with the Lead Architect, consultants, and construction teams. Maintain accurate and up-to-date interior design drawing and document registers within Procore. Review hotel operator and tenant design submissions for compliance with project design guidelines and operational requirements. Provide technical input on FF&E, materials, finishes, and fit-out specifications to support quality, functionality, and coordinated delivery. Liaise with construction, commercial, cost control, leasing, and property management teams to resolve design matters and support informed decisions. Contribute to early-stage feasibility assessments, including interior design scope, standards, and indicative costs. Attend site visits as required to support the resolution of interior design and coordination issues. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in interior design, specifically within residential and hospitality sectors. Demonstrated ability to manage consultants and coordinate complex design packages. Strong technical understanding of interior design principles and construction processes. Compensation and Benefits This position offers a competitive salary, an annual performance bonus, medical insurance, and air tickets. The role provides an opportunity to influence the quality and delivery of residential and hospitality interiors within an in-house design and engineering function, translating design intent into technically robust, coordinated packages.

ce35f6472b31fb9f.description: About the Role Jacobs is seeking a Senior Project Manager - Aviation to join its growing Aviation team in the Middle East. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, KSA, and supports the delivery of major airport infrastructure, terminal, landside, and aviation development projects across all SA Regions. The role requires a blend of technical expertise, project management capabilities, stakeholder management, and commercial awareness. Role Overview The Senior Project Manager will provide technical and project leadership to multidisciplinary teams. This involves overseeing the planning, design, coordination, and delivery of complex aviation projects from concept through detailed design and implementation, ensuring successful outcomes aligned with client objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning, management, and technical delivery of major aviation projects, ensuring alignment with client objectives, budgets, schedules, and quality standards. Manage multidisciplinary design teams across aviation, architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, MEP, airport systems, and specialist disciplines. Provide technical leadership and oversight throughout all project phases, ensuring compliance with international best practices, aviation standards, and client requirements. Develop project execution plans, resource strategies, and delivery programs to ensure successful project outcomes. Coordinate design interfaces between airside, landside, terminal, cargo, and ancillary facility developments. Drive technical reviews, design coordination workshops, value engineering studies, and risk management activities. Monitor project performance, proactively identifying and mitigating technical, commercial, and delivery risks. Manage project budgets, forecasting, change management processes, and commercial performance while ensuring contractual compliance. Lead client engagement activities, acting as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for project stakeholders. Support business development initiatives including proposal preparation, technical submissions, interviews, and client presentations. Foster strong relationships with existing and prospective clients, identifying opportunities for future aviation projects and strategic growth. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. The role requires a strong background in project management and technical leadership within aviation infrastructure projects. Work Environment at Jacobs Jacobs focuses on solving critical problems for cities, environments, and industries globally. The company promotes a culture of caring, inclusivity, and collaboration, leveraging diverse perspectives. Jacobs offers flexible working arrangements and a hybrid working policy, allowing employees to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations, while valuing in-person interactions for culture and client delivery. Application Information The salary for this position is not disclosed. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

ce80c3afd046cf3a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة في المنطقة الشرقية عن موظف مبيعات وتسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية، بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمنتجات وخدمات الشركة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. يشمل النطاق الجغرافي للدور مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، الهفوف، بقيق، راس تنورة، الخفجي، قرية العليا، النعيرية، صفوى، القطيف، سيهات، تاروت، الجش، عنك، دارين، أم الحمام، جواثا، المبرز، العمران، والجفر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية رئيسية في تنمية الأعمال من خلال استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. كما يساهم في تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية التي تدعم نمو الشركة وتوسع قاعدة عملائها، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات تطوير مبيعات B2B في مجال خدمات الموارد البشرية. استقطاب العملاء من قطاع الأعمال وبناء علاقات مهنية مستدامة معهم. الترويج لخدمات الشركة بفعالية وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. متابعة فرص البيع المحتملة حتى إتمام التعاقد بنجاح. المساهمة في تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات والتسويق. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق أعمال الشركة في قطاع خدمات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل، وسيتم الكشف عنه للمرشحين المؤهلين. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

ce87605d26efaea6.description: About International Maritime Industries International Maritime Industries is seeking a Specialist, Expediting to join their team. This full-time role is essential for ensuring the timely delivery of materials and services in accordance with company policies and procedures. Role Overview The Specialist, Expediting is responsible for managing and expediting assigned Purchase Orders/Packages. This position focuses on securing the quality and timely delivery of materials and services to the required destination, ensuring compliance with IMI's operational standards. Key Responsibilities Examine and confirm supplier acknowledgment of purchase orders, verifying the achievability of promised dates, deliverables, and FAT/Inspection activities. Develop and implement expediting follow-up plans tailored to the complexity of each Purchase Order. Determine Incoterms and Payment Milestones (LC/CAD/ABG/PBG) to facilitate the initiation of manufacturing at supplier facilities. Coordinate with suppliers and the Project Team to ensure timely delivery of Package dossier requirements (GAD, ITP, Production Schedule, Quality package, and Final Dossier) as specified in the Purchase Order. Monitor and expedite missing or returned documents/drawings from Suppliers/contractors and Engineering/Operations. Establish and lead weekly Expediting, OSD, and E&P meetings with internal stakeholders as required, monitoring the Return on Spends (ROS) against critical packages. Closely track manufacturers' production schedules (Gantt Charts) to identify delivery improvement opportunities, critical paths, early detection of delays, and mitigation plans. Maintain and update data in relevant systems to ensure accurate tracking of project materials progress. Acquire weekly or bi-weekly progress reports on materials/services. Monitor, control, and mitigate issues that may impact manufacturing, inspection, and delivery timelines. Escalate issues promptly to Supplier senior management and the IMI team, seeking alternative solutions. Maintain an action list from project meetings to provide updates and status of materials/services flow. Identify disruptions in supplier/contractor submission and delivery schedules through regular progress meetings. Communicate regularly with assigned suppliers to ensure the latest delivery information is updated and relayed to the project team. Collaborate with suppliers and the project team to create recovery plans if slippage occurs in the delivery schedule. Coordinate with the IMI warehouse/project team to ensure Goods Receipt Notes (GRN)/Service Entry Sheets (SES) are completed and posted in the ERP system. Facilitate communication between supplier/contractor and IMI finance regarding payment methods and Bank guarantees. Work with the logistics team to arrange shipments from suppliers. Adopt a proactive approach to problem-solving, addressing issues before they escalate. Collaborate with the Buyer, Senior Expeditor / Division Head-Expediting, PPM, and PM, adapting to changes to meet project critical material requirements. Manage Purchase Order volume with shorter lead times for fast-paced projects (MRO). Update and share the weekly Expediting Schedule with relevant stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience 3-9 years of experience in an expediting or related role. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

ce8cbccffcad7e26.description: The Development Senior Manager is responsible for leading development of retail, public realm and special-use components across both precincts. Leading the planning, development, and delivery of commercial office assets within the Commercial Office Business Unit. The role will manage projects from concept through design, procurement, construction, and handover, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya's strategic objectives, business plans, commercial targets, and development standards. Key Responsibilities Act as the principal interface with Place, Culture, Retail and Hospitality, translating their requirements into commercially supported briefs, operating models and coordinated delivery scopes. Manage assigned components in coordination with the respective Project Leads, clarifying funding, approvals, delivery and operational responsibilities. Prepare and manage development briefs, project execution plans, budgets, schedules, and business cases. Coordinate and manage multidisciplinary consultants, ensuring design solutions meet business, operational, and commercial objectives. Drive project governance, approvals, and stakeholder alignment across internal and external parties. Oversee project budgets, forecasts, and financial performance to achieve approved business objectives. Support procurement activities, including tender strategies, bid evaluations, and contract awards. Manage consultant and contractor performance, contractual obligations, variations, claims, and commercial matters. Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while ensuring compliance with company policies and development processes. Coordinate with Delivery, Commercial, Leasing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. Ensure timely project delivery, quality assurance, operational readiness, and smooth asset handover to end users and operators. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Real Estate Development, Urban Planning, Quantity Surveying, Project Management, or a related Master's degree in Real Estate Development, Business Administration (MBA), Construction Management, Project Management, Urban Development, or a related field is preferred. 7+ years of experience in real estate development, project management, design management, or construction. Experience delivering commercial office, mixed-use, or large-scale real estate developments. Experience managing multidisciplinary consultants and contractors. Middle East/GCC experience and exposure to giga-project environments is preferred.

ce9be89c84509752.description: About the Role Jacobs (KSA) is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to support the construction supervision and delivery of Hyperscale Data Center and Mission-Critical Infrastructure projects across All SA Regions, specifically in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on overseeing the installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems to ensure compliance with project specifications, international standards, client requirements, and local authority regulations. Role Context and Objectives The successful candidate will be integral to projects involving Tier III/Tier IV Data Centers and mission-critical electrical infrastructure. This position involves ensuring that all electrical construction activities meet stringent quality and safety standards, from initial design review through to final handover. The role requires coordination with various teams and a strong understanding of complex electrical systems within a data center environment. Key Responsibilities Supervise electrical construction activities to ensure compliance with approved designs, specifications, codes, and standards. Review shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, inspection and test plans, and other technical documentation. Monitor the installation and testing of electrical systems, including substations, HV/MV/LV distribution networks, transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, battery systems, generators, grounding systems, and lightning protection systems. Ensure compliance with Tier III/Tier IV redundancy requirements and mission-critical performance standards. Coordinate electrical works with civil, structural, mechanical, ICT, and commissioning teams. Support testing, energization, integrated systems testing (IST), commissioning, and handover activities. Participate in inspections, audits, quality reviews, and contractor performance assessments. Prepare technical reports and support project progress monitoring. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience as an Electrical Engineer. Demonstrated experience in Tier III/Tier IV Data Centers and mission-critical electrical infrastructure projects. Proficiency in overseeing the installation, testing, and commissioning of complex electrical systems. Ability to ensure compliance with international standards, client requirements, and local authority regulations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, supporting projects across various regions within KSA. ce634adbc93c049d.description: We are seeking an experienced Plant Tissue Culture Technician responsible for the laboratory-based propagation of rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, and high-value plant species using tissue culture and micropropagation techniques . Perform surface sterilisation and maintain strict aseptic techniques to minimise contamination. Maintain detailed records covering explant sources, media formulations, culture dates, subcultures, treatments, contamination rates, multiplication rates, rooting success, and plant survival. Maintain laboratory inventories of culture media components, consumables, chemicals, glassware, and sterile materials. Degree in Biology, Plant Biology, Botany, Biotechnology, Plant Sciences, Horticulture , or a related field. Minimum 5+ years of relevant laboratory experience involving plant tissue culture and micropropagation. Experience propagating rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, or high-value plant species is highly desirable. Strong practical experience in explant selection, preparation, surface sterilisation, and aseptic handling . Demonstrated experience preparing and modifying plant tissue culture media and working with plant growth regulators . Extensive experience maintaining sterile laboratory conditions and controlling contamination. Hands-on experience operating autoclaves, laminar-flow cabinets, growth chambers, pH meters, balances, microscopes , and related laboratory equipment. Experience identifying and troubleshooting contamination, culture decline, abnormal growth, poor multiplication, and rooting problems. Strong laboratory record-keeping, data-management, inventory-management, and technical documentation skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with botanists, horticulturists, researchers, conservation specialists, and academic institutions . Demonstrated ability to train staff, interns, students, or laboratory personnel in tissue culture techniques. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, observational, and problem-solving skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to perform laboratory procedures consistently and precisely. Previous experience in a botanic garden, plant tissue culture laboratory, research institution, university, conservation facility, commercial micropropagation laboratory, or comparable plant-science environment is preferred
